title: Plausibly Exogenous Instruments in Probit Models: Sensitivity Bounds for Average Partial and Interaction Effects
abstract: arXiv:2611.23438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sensitivity analysis for imperfect instruments usually targets a linear two-stage least squares coefficient, yet many applications have binary outcomes and probability-scale targets. We extend the plausibly exogenous framework to the control-function probit, targeting average partial and interaction effects. We derive the generated-regressor variance, union and local-to-zero intervals, and their asymptotic coverage under stated model and calibration conditions. A violation stated on the wrong latent scale can miscalibrate the interval by a factor set by the endogeneity correlation. Applications to Catholic schooling, sibling sex composition and Confucian clans compare probit and linear analyses. Stata and R implementations accompany the analysis.

translated_title: Probit模型中合理外生的工具变量：平均偏效应与交互效应的敏感性边界
translated_abstract: 针对不完美工具变量的敏感性分析通常针对线性两阶段最小二乘系数，然而许多应用中结果变量为二元变量，且目标参数处于概率尺度上。我们将合理外生框架扩展到控制函数probit模型，以平均偏效应和交互效应为目标。我们推导了生成回归元的方差、并集区间和局部趋零区间，以及它们在给定模型和校准条件下的渐近覆盖性质。在错误的潜变量尺度上陈述违背假设会导致区间校准出现偏差，偏差幅度由内生性相关系数决定。论文将该方法应用于天主教学校教育、兄弟姐妹性别构成和儒家宗族的研究，比较了probit分析与线性分析的结果。该分析附有Stata和R的实现代码。
tldr: 本文将合理外生工具变量的敏感性分析框架扩展至控制函数probit模型，针对平均偏效应与交互效应推导了敏感性区间，并指出在错误的潜变量尺度上陈述工具变量违背假设会导致区间校准出现偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the plausibly exogenous instruments sensitivity analysis framework to control-function probit models targeting average partial and interaction effects, deriving sensitivity intervals and showing that stating the violation on the wrong latent scale can miscalibrate the intervals by a factor determined by the endogeneity correlation.
